title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in Procuratorial Public Interest Litigation Cases

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Interpretation is formulated for the correct application of the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and the Administrative Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China concerning the system of public interest litigation instituted by the People's Procuratorate, and in light of the actual circumstances of adjudication and procuratorial work.

Article 2 The main tasks of the People's Court and the People's Procuratorate in handling public interest litigation cases are to fully perform their functions of judicial adjudication and legal supervision, uphold the authority of the Constitution and laws, safeguard social fairness and justice, protect national interests and social public interests, supervise eligible entities to exercise the right of public interest litigation according to law, and promote law-based administration and strict law enforcement.

Article 3 When handling public interest litigation cases, the People's Court and the People's Procuratorate shall abide by the provisions of the Constitution and laws, follow the principles of the litigation system, and comply with the operational rules of adjudicative and procuratorial powers.

Article 4 Where the People's Procuratorate initiates public interest litigation as a plaintiff in a public interest action, it shall enjoy the corresponding litigation rights and perform the corresponding litigation obligations in accordance with the Civil Procedure Law and the Administrative Procedure Law, except as otherwise provided by laws or judicial interpretations.

Article 5 A first-instance civil public interest litigation case initiated by a People's Procuratorate of a city (sub-provincial city, prefecture, or autonomous prefecture) shall be under the jurisdiction of the Intermediate People's Court of the place where the tort is committed or where the defendant is domiciled.
A first-instance administrative public interest litigation case initiated by a Primary People's Procuratorate shall be under the jurisdiction of the Primary People's Court of the place where the defendant administrative organ is located.

Article 6 When handling public interest litigation cases, the People's Procuratorate may investigate and collect evidence materials from relevant administrative organs, other organizations, and citizens; the relevant administrative organs, other organizations, and citizens shall cooperate. Where it is necessary to take measures for preservation of evidence, the matter shall be handled in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Civil Procedure Law and the Administrative Procedure Law.
Article 7 When adjudicating a first-instance public interest litigation case initiated by the People's Procuratorate, the People's Court may apply the people's assessor system.

Article 8 Where the People's Court holds a hearing for a public interest litigation case initiated by the People's Procuratorate, it shall serve the notice of appearance on the People's Procuratorate three days before the hearing.
The People's Procuratorate shall assign personnel to appear before the court and shall, within three days of receiving the notice of appearance from the People's Court, submit a notice of appearance to the People's Court. The notice of appearance shall specify the names and legal positions of the personnel appearing before the court and the specific duties they shall perform.

Article 10 Where the People's Procuratorate disagrees with the judgment or ruling of the first instance made by the People's Court, it may file an appeal with the People's Court at the next higher level.

Article 11 When the People's Court adjudicates a case in the second instance, the People's Procuratorate that initiated the public interest litigation shall assign personnel to appear before the court; the People's Procuratorate at the next higher level may also assign personnel to participate.

Article 12 Where a judgment or ruling in a public interest litigation case initiated by the People's Procuratorate has become legally effective and the defendant fails to comply with it, the People's Court shall transfer it for enforcement.
II. Civil Public Interest Litigation

Article 13 Where, in performing its duties, the People's Procuratorate discovers acts that damage the ecological environment and resources, or infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of many consumers in the fields of food and drug safety, or other acts that harm social public interests, and intends to initiate a public interest action, it shall make a public announcement according to law, and the period of the announcement shall be thirty days.
Where, upon expiration of the announcement period, the organs prescribed by law and relevant organizations do not initiate an action, the People's Procuratorate may file a lawsuit with the People's Court.

Article 15 Where the People's Procuratorate initiates a civil public interest action pursuant to paragraph 2 of Article 55 of the Civil Procedure Law, and it meets the conditions for prosecution prescribed in subparagraphs (2), (3), and (4) of Article 119 of the Civil Procedure Law and the provisions of this Interpretation, the People's Court shall register the case.
Article 16 In a civil public interest litigation case initiated by the People's Procuratorate, if the defendant raises a claim by way of a counterclaim, the People's Court shall not accept it.

Article 17 After accepting a civil public interest litigation case initiated by the People's Procuratorate, the People's Court shall serve a copy of the indictment on the defendant within five days from the date of registration of the case.
Where the People's Procuratorate has already completed the pre-litigation announcement procedure, the People's Court shall not make another announcement after registration.

Article 18 Where the People's Court considers that the litigation claims raised by the People's Procuratorate are insufficient to protect the social public interests, it may explain to the People's Procuratorate and recommend that it change or add claims such as cessation of infringement and restoration to the original state.

Article 19 During the trial of a civil public interest litigation case, if the People's Procuratorate withdraws the action because all its litigation claims have been satisfied, the People's Court shall permit such withdrawal.

Article 20 Where the People's Procuratorate institutes a criminal public prosecution for acts that damage the ecological environment and resources, or infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of many consumers in the fields of food and drug safety, or other acts that harm social public interests, it may simultaneously file an incidental civil public interest action with the People's Court, which shall be adjudicated by the same adjudication panel.
A criminal incidental civil public interest litigation case initiated by the People's Procuratorate shall be under the jurisdiction of the People's Court that adjudicates the criminal case.
III. Administrative Public Interest Litigation

Article 21 Where, in performing its duties, the People's Procuratorate discovers that an administrative organ with supervisory and management duties in the fields of ecological environment and resource protection, food and drug safety, protection of state-owned property, and assignment of the right to use state-owned land has exercised its powers illegally or failed to perform its duties, thereby causing harm to national interests or social public interests, the People's Procuratorate shall issue a procuratorial recommendation to the administrative organ, urging it to perform its duties according to law.
The administrative organ shall perform its duties according to law within two months from the date of receipt of the procuratorial recommendation and shall respond in writing to the People's Procuratorate. In emergency situations where the harm to national interests or social public interests continues to expand, the administrative organ shall respond in writing within fifteen days.
If the administrative organ fails to perform its duties according to law, the People's Procuratorate shall file a lawsuit with the People's Court according to law.

Article 23 Where the People's Procuratorate initiates an administrative public interest action pursuant to paragraph 4 of Article 25 of the Administrative Procedure Law, and it meets the conditions for prosecution prescribed in subparagraphs (2), (3), and (4) of Article 49 of the Administrative Procedure Law and the provisions of this Interpretation, the People's Court shall register the case.

Article 24 During the trial of an administrative public interest litigation case, if the defendant corrects its illegal acts or performs its duties according to law, thereby satisfying all the litigation claims of the People's Procuratorate, and the People's Procuratorate withdraws the action, the People's Court shall rule to permit the withdrawal; if the People's Procuratorate changes its litigation claim to request confirmation that the original administrative act was illegal, the People's Court shall render a judgment confirming the illegality.
Article 26 Matters not provided for in this Interpretation shall be governed by the provisions of the Civil Procedure Law, the Administrative Procedure Law, and relevant judicial interpretations.

Article 27 This Interpretation shall come into force on March 2, 2018.
Where any judicial interpretation or normative document previously issued by the Supreme People's Court or the Supreme People's Procuratorate is inconsistent with this Interpretation, this Interpretation shall prevail.
